title: Suspense, lazy loading and code splitting

videos.script:
Everything the planner does is in one JavaScript file, and every visitor downloads all of it before the first screen. Today you will cut it in two.

{{build}} First the build. One file of three hundred and seventy kilobytes, with a form library inside that only one screen uses.

{{lazy}} Then lazy and Suspense. Three lines in App, and the course screen moves to a file of its own, fetched the first time somebody opens a course. You will watch it arrive on the click, and not before.

{{fallback}} Then where the fallback goes, and what else can make a component wait.

{{gone}} Then the morning after a deploy: a page left open asks for a file that is no longer there, and the error boundary from lesson twelve catches it.

{{early}} And last, fetching the screen before it is needed, so the click does not wait at all, and what that costs the people who never click.
